environment.server: isolated Python HTTP server serving app directory

scope: Browser observations against frozen local app files; not a Figma or cross-browser audit.

checks.name: Desktop list and form
checks.observed: 1440x900: empty state, form, validation, save, search and cancel exercised; scroll width and client width were both 1440.

checks.name: Mobile layout and save retry
checks.observed: 375x812: form interaction, failed-write retry, and subsequent save exercised; scroll width and client width were both 375.

checks.name: Keyboard entry and validation focus
checks.observed: Tab and Shift+Tab exercised on list and form: list reached Add/Search, form reached title/content/cancel/save/back. Enter activated Add; whitespace submit showed error and focused title. Title, content and search accessible labels found. Initial describedby referenced hints only; invalid title referenced hint and error; correcting it removed error association.

checks.name: Save and reload
checks.observed: Saved Alpha 제목 with Beta 내용; card with date and content remained after reload. Cancelled draft did not add a card.

checks.name: Failed write preserves draft and retry saves
checks.observed: Injected a synchronous readwrite transaction failure; error appeared, form remained open and both inputs remained. Restored transaction and retry added the card.

checks.name: Concurrent writes and live refresh
checks.observed: Two tabs saved distinct titles concurrently; both cards appeared in both tabs. A subsequent save appeared in the other tab without manual reload.

checks.name: Search and empty states
checks.observed: Fresh store showed empty guidance; searching it showed no-results guidance. Case-insensitive title and content searches matched; unmatched search showed no-results guidance.

checks.name: Browser console and page errors
checks.observed: Stagehand page console and pageerror listeners on the main page captured no messages during the exercised flow. The requestfailed event is unsupported by the compatibility facade.

checks.name: Inline favicon
checks.observed: Document favicon is a data SVG; isolated server log contained no favicon request.

limitations: One Chromium browser; no screen reader audit or exhaustive keyboard-only workflow.
Failure was injected at the IndexedDB readwrite transaction boundary, not caused by a real quota or disk failure.
Console and pageerror listeners observed the main page; requestfailed event was unsupported and a complete network log was not collected.
Viewport checks do not establish behavior at every size or browser.
